description.value:
Something that used to be smaller and softer, now plated in chitin or scavenged armor plate it grew into rather than strapped on. Rideable by Alpha stage.

SIGNATURE — can plant itself to grant you cover, and by Apex-Touched stage can carry you at a dead run without slowing.

cinderfall.incomplete: No numbers stated at all; the ability lives entirely on the companion's own actions (cross-creature) and is stage-gated with no stage tracked anywhere. This effect buffs, protects, or grants actions to the Feral Bond (the companion beast) from the holder's own card. No rule-element selector in pf2e-source lets one actor's item grant a stat bonus, temp HP, an extra action, or a shared sense to a different actor's sheet -- confirmed by spot-checking real pf2e's own fully-built Animal Companion subsystem (Ranger/Druid), where virtually every companion-buff/companion-action-economy feat ships with rules: [] too. Feral Bond growth stages (Whelp / Bonded / Alpha / Apex-Touched, classes.waywarden.json:95 terms) have no tracked data field anywhere in the corpus, so a stage requirement like "at least Alpha stage" has no roll option or actor property to predicate against.
